title: Matchday 1 — Germany Run Riot, Late Drama Elsewhere

slides.hook: Germany *bury* Curaçao seven-one to open matchday one.
slides.note: Next openers are loading. We chart every goal. Trust the *board*.

slides.headline: Curaçao *answer* an early German strike
slides.body: Nmecha opens at six minutes, Wirtz supplying. Curaçao refuse the script. Comenencia *equalises* at 21. One-one, and briefly the favourites look mortal.

slides.headline: The dam *breaks* before and after the half
slides.body: Schlotterbeck heads Germany back ahead at 38. Havertz converts deep in first-half stoppage. Musiala strikes at 47. From there the *flood* arrives — Brown, Undav, and Havertz again pile on for seven.

slides.context: Sweden run riot. Ayari *bookends* it with goals at 7 and 90+6. Isak turns provider three times; Rekik's 43rd-minute reply was Tunisia's only answer.
Van Dijk and Summerville twice nudge the Dutch ahead. Japan *answer* both — Kamada striking at 89 to steal a point. Three Dutch yellows tell the story.
Goalless until the *death*. Amad Diallo pokes home at 90, Singo assisting. Four bookings underline a tense, scrappy night in Group play.

slides.note: Tomorrow: Spain vs Cape Verde, Belgium vs Egypt & 2 more.

stories.big: Germany pressed, Curaçao buckled, and the board *filled* up fast.
